claim: 실제 AKH는 AKE와 같은 한쪽 날개 단면에 높이만 45 in로 낮은 형태
evidence: Lufthansa Cargo brochure (https://lufthansa-cargo.com/documents/d/guest/brochure_pallets_containers_and_fleet), AKH - LD3-45 container: 'External dimensions 61.4 x 60.2 x 45 in ... External dimensions of shell top (L x W) 96 x 60.2 in' (244 x 154 cm), whereas AKE: 'External dimensions of shell top 79 x 60.4 in' (201 x 154 cm). VRR contour summary PDF: 'Contour H Width: 2438 mm / 96 in, Height: 1143 mm / 45 in'. So the VRR 96 in figure is confirmed; AKH's top is 96 in wide, not the AKE one-wing 79 in profile.
fix: VRR 요약은 96 in(2438 mm). Lufthansa도 AKH 상부 외부 치수를 96 × 60.2 in(244 × 154 cm)로 적어, AKH는 바닥은 AKE와 같지만 윗부분이 96 in로 넓은 낮은(45 in) 형태입니다

evidence: Same source: Lufthansa lists AKH shell top 96 x 60.2 in vs AKE shell top 79 x 60.4 in, so AKH does not share the LD3 (AKE) cross-section; VRR contour H width 96 in. The AKH outline drawn in the 읽기 연습 table (same one-wing polygon as AKE, only lower) is therefore also inaccurate.
fix: AKH(LD3-45)는 바닥 61.5 × 60.4 in에 높이 45 in이며, 윗부분 폭은 96 in(Lufthansa 상부 외부 244 × 154 cm, VRR 컨투어 H)로 AKE보다 넓습니다. (AKH 모양 SVG도 윗폭 96 in 기준으로 다시 그려야 함)

claim: 액티브는 외부 길이가 약 200 cm로 LD3 기본 치수보다 큽니다(장비부)
evidence: Lufthansa brochure: Envirotainer RKN-e1 'External dimensions 201 x 154 x 163 cm (77.3 x 59.3 x 63.6 in)', CSafe RKN '200 x 154 x 163 cm (78.7 x 60.4 x 63.8 in)'; the same brochure gives the ordinary AKE 'External dimensions of shell top 201 x 154 cm (79 x 60.4 in)'. VRR contour E/N width 2007 mm / 79 in. The ~200 cm is simply the standard LD3 contour envelope (top width 79 in), not an equipment overhang beyond LD3 dimensions.
fix: Lufthansa는 액티브 RKN의 외부 치수를 약 200 × 154 × 163 cm로 적는데, 이는 LD3 컨투어의 윗폭(79 in, 약 201 cm)까지 잰 값으로 일반 AKE의 상부 외부 치수와 같습니다.

evidence: https://www.uldcare.com/articles/library/care/uld-identification-codes-demystified/ shows only '30 Oct' with no year and no revision date in the fetched page text; the article content itself (17 categories, 15 base letters, 'About 20 years ago', Resolution 686, 100 mm / 300 mm marking rules) matches the document.
